questions.question: In Artificial Intelligence systems, what role does data primarily play?
options: It acts as the information used for learning

questions.question: In the kitchen analogy used to explain AI, what does an algorithm represent?
options: The recipe that guides the process

questions.question: Which combination correctly forms the basic foundation of most AI systems?
What is the key idea behind Machine Learning compared to traditional programming?
options: Computers learn patterns from data instead of following fixed rules

questions.question: When a computer studies thousands of examples and discovers patterns on its own, which concept is being demonstrated?
Which situation best represents how Machine Learning works?
options: A computer follows exact instructions written by a programmer
A computer studies many examples and finds patterns by itself
A computer stores files without analysis

questions.question: In Supervised Learning, what special feature does the training data contain?
Teaching an AI to recognize good and bad logos using labeled examples is an example of:
In Unsupervised Learning, what is the main task given to the AI system?
options: Find hidden patterns in unlabeled data

questions.question: Grouping customers based on their buying habits without knowing their identities is an example of:
Which Machine Learning method learns through rewards and penalties?
Training an AI to improve at a game like chess by rewarding successful moves is an example of:
Which real-world system commonly uses Supervised Learning to protect users?
When an email system moves suspicious messages to a spam folder, what is the AI mainly analyzing?
options: Patterns found in past spam emails
The color of the email text

questions.question: Face unlock on smartphones works by studying which type of information?
During Face Unlock setup, why does the phone ask the user to move their head in different directions?
options: To collect detailed facial data from multiple angles

questions.question: What does the term AI Bias refer to?
options: AI systems working faster than humans
AI making unfair decisions because of biased training data

questions.question: If an AI hiring system is trained mostly on resumes of men, what problem might occur?
options: The AI may unfairly prefer male candidates
The AI will only hire programmers

questions.question: The phrase 'Garbage In, Garbage Out' in AI means:
options: Bad input data leads to incorrect results

questions.question: What is the most important responsibility of humans when building AI systems?
options: Provide fair and balanced training data
